thesis: Investment must fund falsifiable evidence under serious privacy, bias, security and business risks.
role: Define regulatory safeguards, milestones and kill criteria.

ideas.statement: Privacy, human involvement in consequential decisions, correction, criteria audits, recourse and accessible representation constrain deployment.
Platform absorption, disclosure refusal, supervision costs, services dependence and commoditization may defeat the thesis; capital follows measured progress.

After a focused twelve-month pilot, weak candidate acceptance, spam-like invitations, persistent manual work, absent private intent, poor net time savings or weak retention require reconsideration; manipulation winning later requires not scaling.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Regulatory classification depends on function, deployment and jurisdiction, while matching criteria are not value-neutral.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
